CRM notes:
- Company profile: mid-market product analytics SaaS (B2B, product-led growth). Building in-app onboarding copilot (guided flows) to reduce time-to-value for new customers. Primary KPI: reduce onboarding drop-off by 20%.
- Workload specifics: chat/agent-style flows embedded in product UI, heavy use of tool-calling to query user accounts and surface contextual links. Typical session = 6-10 turns, average prompt length ~300 tokens, target cap per session 1.5k tokens.
- Latency requirements: want consistent interactive feel. Stated target: p50 150-250ms, p95 < 600ms for onboarding steps. Prefer streaming responses to show progressive hints.
- Cost sensitivity: tight token budgets for onboarding flows; product team needs token cost caps per flow and ability to failover to smaller/quantized model when thresholds hit. Quote: "If we can get predictable token costs and sub-250ms p50, we can commit to Dedicated."
- Model preferences: open models OK if latency and cost hit targets; willing to evaluate Redwood-verified variants. Need tool-calling + structured output (JSON) for actionability.
- Security/compliance: must support SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS integration, and U.S. data residency. InfoSec requested architecture diagram + SOC2 evidence.
- POC scope: 2-week hosted API POC. Benchmarks to capture: streaming startup latency, per-token cost, KV/prefix caching impact on subsequent steps, tool-call reliability. Run synthetic concurrency test and small in-product beta (~100 users) to validate UX.
- Pricing: interested in Hosted for quick start; move to Dedicated if POC meets latency/cost SLAs. Ask for Dedicated tier pricing for baseline 4 GPUs equivalent with 2x burst.
- Stakeholders: VP Product (Elena Torres), Head of Eng (Rahul Patel), InfoSec (Marta Gomez), CFO (review pricing).
- Quote from VP Product: "We need the copilot to feel native — not slow. If it feels laggy, users drop off."
- Internal notes / AE playbook: focus demo on streaming + tool call reliability; show caching and batching recommendations from Redwood Optimize; provide a short runbook for switching model variants to meet cost caps.
- Risks: InfoSec turnaround time could delay Dedicated procurement; CFO pushback on ARR commitments.
- Next internal ask: SE Marcus to provide POC checklist + sample request profiler by 2025-03-21. AE to coordinate pricing deck update and Dedicated estimate by 2025-03-24.
